# Unmodified official Moonlight Embedded 2.7.1 public headers

The streaming API header is from the official common-c submodule
`b126e481a195fdc7152d211def17190e3434bcce`, referenced by Moonlight Embedded
`775444287305849ebdf4736c75298ad0713e2d5d`. The other public headers and GPLv3
license are from that Embedded revision. They do not implement any protocol.

`native/stream/src/ffi.rs` is generated by Debian's bindgen 0.71.1 using the
unmodified `Limelight.h` and dynamic loading. Its constant layout assertions
target Linux AMD64 and ARM64. The runtime adapter must load only the matching
`libmoonlight-common.so.2.7.1`; an unversioned/unknown-ABI library is not suitable.
No C variadic function is defined in Rampi; the optional protocol log callback
remains unset. No newer Rust compiler or nightly toolchain is required for it.

Reproduction with installed bindgen and libclang:

```sh
bindgen vendor/moonlight-headers/Limelight.h \
  --dynamic-loading Moonlight --dynamic-link-require-all \
  --allowlist-function 'Li(Initialize.*|StartConnection|StopConnection|InterruptConnection|SendMouse.*|SendKeyboard.*|Send.*Scroll.*|GetLaunchUrlQueryParameters)' \
  --no-doc-comments --rust-edition 2021 --output native/stream/src/ffi.rs
cargo fmt --all
```

The public API retains upstream licensing. Rampi's own Rust adapter code is
Apache-2.0; redistribution must also meet the upstream GPL source and notice
obligations. Neither these bindings nor the transport tests prove completion of
embedded streaming. The GTK and actual Sunshine media acceptance remain required.
